snapshot.scope: One hourly complete project snapshot. Unchanged predecessor frozen bytes may share immutable inodes; no live research source is linked. All originals remain byte-hashed.

scope: Complete standalone snapshot with every verified predecessor content object and the complete predecessor manifest. Exact original bytes, full proofs/code/logs/attempts and documented supplied/external source-payload exclusions.

inherited_transport_repairs.scope: Every original frozen and predecessor content byte is unchanged. Member codecs are verified before existing PNG/copy-add decoding; all decoder modules and payloads are delivered.

dictionary_representation.scope: All original dictionary, row-index, TAR and research content bytes are unchanged.

checkpoint33_exact_member_repair.scope: Every original member reconstructs byte-for-byte through delivered unchanged codecs; each retained residual member was independently rehashed. The complete standalone restore remains a separate gate.

checkpoint33_dictionary_outer_representa.scope: An additional reversible byte-plane layer reconstructs the identical original dictionary before every unchanged inherited PNG-row decoder. Original row indices, all inherited representation records, and the immutable32 ZIP remain unchanged.
